method: Each negative runs twice: in the simulator (generated JavaScript, honest checks) and at the proof server with the JavaScript checks that would refuse it bypassed in a patched copy of the generated contract, after a positive control proved through the same copy. A case passes only when it is refused at the expected layer and the refusal is attributed to the circuit under test.

layers.constraint: a relation over the call's own inputs and witnesses fails at /check (400)
layers.constraint on a declared read (+ node tr: the assert tests a ledger or call-context read the prover declares; an honest prover is refused at /check; a malicious prover's declared value is refused by the node's transcript replay
layers.decoding: the honest proof server refuses the input encoding (not a constraint)
layers.runtime-only: the generated JavaScript refuses; the prover level is unreachable (reason recorded)
